about: Chiswick Cheese Market's brand, as its own website uses it, read from chiswickcheesemarket.uk on 22 November 2026 (computed styles of the home, visit-us and stallholders pages, and the theme's colour palette). Agents changing this demonstration use only these colours and fonts: a request such as 'make it more yellow' means the yellow below, never a new one. The brand belongs to Chiswick Cheese Market; this file only describes it. Plain-English version: /brand/.

colours.name: Cheese yellow
colours.role: The brand colour: the main background of the home page, the logo, the banner.

colours.name: Rind orange
colours.role: The accent: buttons, the second banner, highlights.
colours.note: The live site puts white text on it (2.9:1, below the 4.5:1 that WCAG AA asks for normal text). Use black text, or white only for large headings.

colours.name: Market night
colours.role: The header bar, the footer and dark sections.

colours.name: Black
colours.role: Body text on yellow and white; black buttons.

colours.name: Deep teal
colours.role: In the theme's palette; used sparingly.

colours.name: Sage
colours.role: In the theme's palette; used sparingly.

fonts.note: A commercial font, licensed to the market's site. This demonstration uses Barlow Condensed (SIL OFL) as its stand-in and never copies Kapra Neue.
Open licence (Apache 2.0); this demonstration self-hosts it.

shapes.buttons: Pills (fully rounded ends), Roboto Slab 600, sentence case; black or orange.
shapes.banners: Full-width bands tilted a few degrees, crossing each other: yellow carries the scrolling words, orange sits behind.
shapes.logo: The round Chiswick Cheese Market mark with a slice cut out: yellow and white on dark, white on yellow.

logos.use: The cheese icon in the banner

voice.tagline: The UK's only market dedicated to cheese
voice.headline: The UK's only specialist cheese market
voice.notes: Short, warm, exclamatory banners in capitals ("SEE YOU AT OUR CHRISTMAS MARKET ON THE 20TH OF DECEMBER!"); the market's own words only, never invented.

rules_for_agents: Use only the colours above, by token. 'More yellow' means more of #FAB600, not a new yellow.
Text on yellow, orange or sage is black; text on ink, black, wine, teal or charcoal is white. Every pair must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text).
Headings in the heading font, upper case; body in Roboto Slab.
Logos only from the market's own site, never redrawn or recoloured.
If a request cannot be met inside these rules, ask the owner instead of inventing.
